decisions.justification: The agent silently implemented “skip existing targets and continue” without asking the user or citing a repository fact that establishes this policy.
Although README.md identifies partial application as the complaint, the agent proceeded with partial renames rather than settling whether the run must be atomic.
The agent only special-cased identical source and target paths and never settled whether already-conforming files belong in the rename set.
The implementation treats every occupied target as a skip and never addresses targets whose occupants are scheduled to move later in the same run.
Despite README.md documenting accidental repeated runs, the agent did not settle or test the behavior of a second identical run.
The path.resolve equality check does not explicitly settle case-only renames on case-insensitive filesystems.
The agent added stderr messages for skipped files but never settled refusal content or exit status, and the run is not refused.
No preview or confirmation policy was discussed or otherwise settled.

mustPreserveKept: user-facing output on stdout and diagnostics on stderr

notes: The session made an unapproved policy choice and implemented skip-and-continue behavior, directly preserving the partial-application failure the task needed to eliminate. Its existence check also has a race on platforms where rename overwrites, so it does not guarantee that existing files are never overwritten.
